title: Place list and form
goal: The owner adds a place with just a name and fills the rest later
acceptance: List of places; add with a name only; edit form for description, category, tags, notes and time spent (2 h, half day, full day)
Signal Forms, keyboard and screen-reader accessible; component tests
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: scoped to one PR, at most 1.5 focused day(s). Not a measurement.
